answer: Sequential time is the gate, not capital. Each key must extend its own verifiable delay chain: 40 million sequential squarings, one link per epoch and never more. Parallel cores cannot shorten a single chain, and the node checks the delta between your old and new root, so a skipped link voids the account. Ten thousand duplicate accounts need ten thousand independent chains, near 111 core-hours and $7.40 per epoch, plus thirty witnessed epochs before depth counts. Picture cedar rings: a trunk gains one ring a year, and no pile of saplings bought today buys an old spiral.
